mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 6.0% for three consecutive months, it indicates labor market weakness that triggers central bank policy accommodation, boosting equity demand and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 6.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in federal funds rate and rise in unemployment rate indicates dovish policy response to labor market deterioration, compressing risk-free rates and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days through market anticipation of further easing.
regime_hint: dovish policy response to labor weakness
failure_condition: The joint signal of FEDFUNDS decline and UNRATE rise fails to produce positive returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term coefficient has p>0.05 in regression.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion phases characterized by sustained consumer spending growth (RSAFS > 0.5% monthly), corporate earnings momentum supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion regimes, 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC for RSAFS falls below 0.02 in this regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals strengthening labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS rises for 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 for two consecutive months, it signals manufacturing contraction that increases recession risk, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates broad economic slowdown, increasing recession expectations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining HOUST and INDPRO fails to produce negative returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term coefficient has p<0.05 with positive sign.

mechanism_narrative: In post-2008 recovery phases with persistent low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.0% annualized), the Federal Reserve maintains accommodative policy, supporting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In post-2008 recovery with CPIAUCSL < 2.0%, 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC for CPIAUCSL in this regime falls below 0.02.
